payload.summary: Verify worker parser isolation and crash/retry/ambiguous-ack recovery on an isolated stack
payload.detail: 2026-11-05 backend audit (ING-RAG-01, EXT-ROLES-JOBS-02, EXT-STREAM-01, EXT-STREAM-02, EXT-STREAM-03, F05, F09, R02, V04, V05, V09), local source33f6478: Actual SQL claims/fencing/rollback pass, but full process crash around external effects and acknowledgement, retries, revocation/deletion replay, parser OS/network isolation and cancellation are not established. Next: Prepare owned isolated real-stack fixtures with fault injection and bounded provider test contracts; inspect target/side effects/cost before any provider-backed run. Acceptance: Crash at durable write/external acceptance/ack boundaries; duplicates/out-of-order/revoked owner/stale lease/delete-replay produce intended effects only, bounded retries/cost and diagnosable state. Env stripping/offline flags are not an OS sandbox. Suggested owner: Workers + Database + integrations + Delivery. No merge, deployment, live migration, provider spending or specialist approval is granted by logging this task.
